_comment: One entry per upstream skill. tools/install_skills.py copies each skill into .github/skills/ and injects an adapter block built from these fields. Tool names are canonical TradingView MCP names that .github/tradingview-adapter.md maps to the configured servers. status: native | adapted | partial | user-files | opt-in. net_scripts (optional) overrides the automatic network-script scan when it is a false positive.

skills.name: backtest-expert
skills.upstream: strategy parameters and OHLCV you provide
skills.use: When it needs price history, use `get_ohlcv` (up to 5000 bars).

skills.name: breadth-chart-analyst
skills.upstream: breadth chart images, plus TraderMonty's public breadth CSV
skills.use: Analyze the chart images the user attaches (TradingView screenshots work). For numbers, use breadth series found with `search_symbols` (for example % of S&P 500 stocks above their 200-day MA) and `get_ohlcv`, where the configured servers carry them.
skills.gaps: TraderMonty's breadth CSV is not used.

skills.name: breakout-trade-planner
skills.upstream: VCP screener output and account size
skills.use: Take candidates from the adapted `vcp-screener` output; prices and ATR from `get_symbol_data` or `get_technicals_rating`.
skills.gaps: Order templates are text for human review only. Never submit them to Alpaca or any broker.

skills.name: canslim-screener
skills.use: Build the universe with `run_screener` (market `america`, or `india`) using EPS and revenue growth, ROE, distance from 52-week high, performance and volume columns. Score each CANSLIM factor per the references with `get_financial_history` (`fq`, `fy`), `get_symbol_data`, `get_forecasts`, and `get_ohlcv` on `SP:SPX` for market direction.
skills.gaps: 13F-based institutional sponsorship (I) is not available. Use institutional-holder data if a server provides it (for example `yahoo-finance` `get_holder_info`); otherwise mark I as unscored.

skills.name: contrarian-setup-gate
skills.upstream: reports from cot-contrarian-detector, news-reaction-failure-analyzer and technical-analyst
skills.use: No direct data access; it combines the upstream skill reports.

skills.name: cot-contrarian-detector
skills.upstream: CFTC Commitments of Traders data through the FMP API
skills.use: Check whether the configured servers expose COT series (`search_symbols` with 'COT' plus the market name). If they do, read them with `get_ohlcv`; futures prices come from `get_ohlcv` on the continuous contract.
skills.gaps: If no COT series is available, this skill cannot score crowding. Say so and stop.

skills.name: crypto-regime-analyzer
skills.use: Prices and market caps from crypto symbols (for example `CRYPTOCAP:TOTAL`, `CRYPTOCAP:BTC.D`, `BINANCE:BTCUSDT`, or Yahoo `BTC-USD`) with `get_ohlcv` and `get_symbol_data_batch`. Look for funding-rate or open-interest data with `get_screener_columns` (market `crypto`). Pass the snapshot to the analyzer with `--input-json`.
skills.gaps: Funding rates may not be available; score that component as missing.

skills.name: data-quality-checker
skills.use: Check figures against the MCP data servers when a claim needs verifying.

skills.name: dividend-growth-pullback-screener
skills.use: `run_screener` for dividend yield of at least 1.5%, dividend growth and RSI(14) of 40 or below, with quality filters; `get_dividends_calendar` and `get_financial_history` (`fy`) for dividend and earnings growth; `get_technicals_rating` for RSI.
skills.gaps: Multi-year dividend CAGR needs per-name history; label it as estimated when the history is short.

skills.name: downtrend-duration-analyzer
skills.use: Daily bars from `get_ohlcv` (up to 5000) for each symbol or sector ETF; prepare the data file the script reads with `--input`.

skills.name: drawdown-circuit-breaker
skills.upstream: trader-memory-core state in `state/` and your account size
skills.use: No market data needed.

skills.name: dual-axis-skill-reviewer
skills.use: Skills live in `.github/skills/`. For the LLM axis, write the review yourself and pass it with `--llm-review-json`. Do not call the `claude` CLI.

skills.name: earnings-calendar
skills.use: For a market-wide view, use `run_screener` filtered on the next-earnings-date column (find it with `get_screener_columns`, search 'earnings') and market cap. For specific symbols, use `get_earnings_calendar`.

skills.name: earnings-trade-analyzer
skills.use: Recent reporters from `run_screener` (last-earnings-date column). Gap, pre-earnings trend, volume trend and MA50/MA200 position from `get_ohlcv` daily bars and `get_symbol_data`.

skills.name: economic-calendar-fetcher
skills.use: `get_economic_calendar` with `countries` (for example `US,IN`), the date window and `min_importance`.

skills.name: fxmacrodata-calendar
skills.use: `get_economic_calendar` filtered by `currencies` and importance; `get_economic_data` for the actual series.

skills.name: edge-candidate-agent
skills.use: Build the observations from `run_screener` (movers, volume, new highs) and `get_ohlcv`.

skills.name: edge-concept-synthesizer
skills.upstream: edge tickets and hints from the other edge skills
skills.use: No direct data access.

skills.name: edge-hint-extractor
skills.upstream: market summary and anomaly JSON from earlier steps
skills.use: Build the inputs from outputs based on the MCP data servers. You perform the optional LLM ideation step yourself.

skills.name: edge-pipeline-orchestrator
skills.use: Runs the edge skills in order. Each step uses its own adapter.

skills.name: edge-signal-aggregator
skills.upstream: outputs of edge-candidate-agent, theme-detector, sector-analyst and institutional-flow-tracker
skills.use: No direct data access.

skills.name: edge-strategy-designer
skills.use: No direct data access.

skills.name: edge-strategy-reviewer
skills.use: No direct data access.

skills.name: exposure-coach
skills.use: Combines the adapted market-breadth-analyzer, uptrend-analyzer and market-top-detector outputs.
skills.gaps: Inherits the approximations of those upstream reports.

skills.name: finviz-screener
skills.upstream: FinViz screener URLs opened in a browser
skills.use: Translate the request into `run_screener` filters (market `america`, or `india` for Indian stocks) and return the rows. Do not open FinViz.
skills.gaps: A FinViz filter with no screener equivalent is reported as unsupported.

skills.name: ftd-detector
skills.use: Daily bars from `get_ohlcv` for `SP:SPX` and `NASDAQ:IXIC` (or `AMEX:SPY`, `NASDAQ:QQQ`); apply the skill's rally-attempt and follow-through rules.

skills.name: futures-position-sizer
skills.upstream: entry, stop, account size and its contract table
skills.use: Prices from `get_symbol_data` when needed.

skills.name: ibd-distribution-day-monitor
skills.upstream: FMP OHLCV for QQQ and SPY
skills.use: Daily bars from `get_ohlcv` for `NASDAQ:QQQ` and `AMEX:SPY`; apply the skill's distribution-day rules.

skills.name: institutional-flow-tracker
skills.use: Ownership columns if `get_screener_columns` lists any (search 'institution'); filings with `get_documents`.
skills.gaps: Quarter-over-quarter 13F holdings and fund flows are not available; report them as a gap. A current institutional-holder snapshot may be (for example `yahoo-finance` `get_holder_info`, mainly US listings).

skills.name: kanchi-dividend-review-monitor
skills.upstream: holdings snapshot and the FMP API
skills.use: Holdings from `portfolio/holdings.csv`; dividends from `get_dividends_calendar`; fundamentals from `get_financials` and `get_financial_history`.

skills.name: kanchi-dividend-sop
skills.upstream: FMP API and a public CSV universe
skills.use: Universe from `run_screener` (yield, payout, growth columns); per-name data from `get_financial_history` and `get_dividends_calendar`. Local scripts accept `--input` and `--events-json`.

skills.name: kanchi-dividend-us-tax-accounting
skills.upstream: dividend records and US tax forms
skills.use: No market data needed.
skills.gaps: Covers US tax rules only. Say so for Indian-resident or INR accounts.

skills.name: macro-regime-detector
skills.use: Weekly bars from `get_ohlcv` for the cross-asset ETFs and indices the skill names (resolve with `search_symbols`, for example `AMEX:RSP`, `AMEX:SPY`, `AMEX:HYG`, `AMEX:LQD`, `AMEX:IWM`). Yields from `TVC:US10Y` and `TVC:US02Y`, or from `get_economic_data`.

skills.name: manifoldbt-backtester
skills.upstream: the manifoldbt engine and a local OHLCV file
skills.use: Install `manifoldbt` yourself. Build the OHLCV file from `get_ohlcv` bars.

skills.name: market-breadth-analyzer
skills.use: Approximate it with breadth series found with `search_symbols` (% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50- and 200-day MA, NYSE advance/decline) and `get_ohlcv`, and with screener counts of stocks above SMA50 and SMA200.
skills.gaps: TraderMonty's composite data is not used. Label the scores as approximations.

skills.name: market-environment-analysis
skills.use: `get_symbol_data_batch` for indices, FX, yields and commodities; `get_economic_calendar`; `get_news` on index and FX symbols. `scripts/market_utils.py` is local.

skills.name: market-news-analyst
skills.use: `get_news` and `get_news_story` on holdings and on index, FX and commodity symbols (`NSE:NIFTY`, `SP:SPX`, `FX_IDC:USDINR`, `TVC:UKOIL`); `get_economic_calendar` for macro events.
skills.gaps: No configured source guarantees coverage of RBI, SEBI, NSE, BSE or Government of India circulars.

skills.name: market-top-detector
skills.upstream: public breadth CSV, FMP and yfinance
skills.use: Distribution days from `get_ohlcv` (`SP:SPX`, `NASDAQ:IXIC`); leading-stock deterioration from `run_screener`; defensive rotation from sector ETFs with `get_ohlcv`.
skills.gaps: TraderMonty breadth data is not used. Label the approximations.

skills.name: mt5-robot-tester
skills.upstream: a local MetaTrader 5 terminal, Expert Advisor files and broker tick data
skills.use: Nothing from the MCP servers. It runs on your MT5 installation.

skills.name: news-reaction-failure-analyzer
skills.use: News from `get_news` and `get_news_story`; price reaction from `get_ohlcv`. The script accepts `--events-json` and `--detector-json`.

skills.name: options-strategy-advisor
skills.use: Spot price and historical volatility from `get_symbol_data` and `get_ohlcv`. The Black-Scholes math is local.
skills.gaps: Use option chains if a server provides them (for example `yahoo-finance` `get_option_chain`, US listings); Greeks are not provided, so compute them locally with Black-Scholes. Otherwise ask the user for premiums and IV, or label values as theoretical.

skills.name: pair-trade-screener
skills.use: Peers from `run_screener`; bars from `get_ohlcv` on the same interval for each candidate. Compute correlation, hedge ratio and spread z-score from those bars.

skills.name: parabolic-short-trade-planner
skills.upstream: FMP and Alpaca (short inventory, live 5-minute bars)
skills.use: Screen with `run_screener` (large multi-day gains, relative volume); intraday bars from `get_ohlcv` (interval `5`).
skills.gaps: Short-borrow availability is not available. Never send orders.

skills.name: pead-screener
skills.use: Post-earnings gap-ups from `run_screener` and weekly bars from `get_ohlcv`; report dates from `get_earnings_calendar`. The script accepts `--candidates-json`.

skills.name: portfolio-manager
skills.use: Holdings from `portfolio/holdings.csv`, prices from `get_symbol_data_batch`. `scripts/review_csv.py --input <csv> --as-of <timestamp with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-29T16:00:00-04:00>` reviews a CSV with columns `symbol,asset_type,quantity,direction,price,currency` (`asset_type` is `equity`, `direction` is `LONG` or `SHORT`).
skills.gaps: `review_csv.py` accepts USD equities only. Review INR holdings with the method by hand, or convert them at a dated FX rate and say so.

skills.name: position-sizer
skills.use: Prices and ATR from the MCP servers. It prints `$` for any currency, so report amounts in the instrument's currency.

skills.name: pre-trade-discipline-gate
skills.upstream: checklist, exposure decision, circuit-breaker decision and thesis record
skills.use: No market data needed.

skills.name: residual-edge-analyzer
skills.use: Build baseline returns from `get_ohlcv` when needed.

skills.name: scenario-analyzer
skills.use: Related news from `get_news` and `get_news_story` on the affected companies, sector ETFs, indices and FX. Delegate to the `scenario-analyst` and `strategy-reviewer` custom agents.

skills.name: sector-analyst
skills.upstream: chart images and TraderMonty's sector uptrend CSV
skills.use: Sector ETFs (`AMEX:XLK`, `AMEX:XLF` and so on) or NSE sector indices from `get_ohlcv` and `get_symbol_data_batch`; charts the user attaches.
skills.gaps: TraderMonty's sector uptrend CSV is not used.

skills.name: signal-postmortem
skills.use: Outcome prices from `get_ohlcv`.

skills.name: skill-designer
skills.use: Create new skills under `.github/skills/<name>/` and keep the workspace data rules in `.github/tradingview-adapter.md`.

skills.name: skill-idea-miner
skills.use: Give it exported chat transcripts instead.
skills.gaps: Copilot sessions are not stored in the Claude Code log format.

skills.name: skill-integration-tester
skills.use: Workflows are in `workflows/*.yaml` and the rules are in `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (not `CLAUDE.md`).

skills.name: stanley-druckenmiller-investment
skills.use: Combines the adapted upstream reports.
skills.gaps: Inherits the gaps of those reports.

skills.name: stockbee-20pct-study
skills.use: Daily movers from `run_screener` (change of at least +20% or -20%); bars from `get_ohlcv`; news from `get_news`. The script accepts `--prices-json`, `--news-json` and `--events-json`.

skills.name: stockbee-episodic-pivot-analyzer
skills.use: Catalysts from `get_news`, `get_documents` and `get_earnings_calendar`; bars from `get_ohlcv`. The script accepts `--prices-json`, `--events-json`, `--earnings-json` and `--momentum-json`.

skills.name: stockbee-exhaustion-hammer-screener
skills.use: Universe from `run_screener`; bars from `get_ohlcv`. The script accepts `--prices-json`, `--profiles-json` and `--universe-file`.

skills.name: stockbee-momentum-burst-screener
skills.use: Candidates from `run_screener` (change of at least 4%, relative volume); bars from `get_ohlcv`. The script accepts `--prices-json` and `--universe-file`.

skills.name: stockbee-setup-fluency-trainer
skills.use: Bars from `get_ohlcv`. The script accepts `--prices-json` and `--screener-json`.

skills.name: strategy-pivot-designer
skills.use: No market data needed.

skills.name: technical-analyst
skills.use: Chart images the user attaches, or weekly bars from `get_ohlcv` (interval `1W`) and `get_technicals_rating` (`1W`).

skills.name: theme-detector
skills.upstream: FMP, FinViz, yfinance and uptrend CSV data
skills.use: Industry and sector performance from `run_screener`; theme ETFs and leaders from `get_ohlcv`.
skills.gaps: FinViz industry tables and TraderMonty uptrend data are not used.

skills.name: trade-hypothesis-ideator
skills.upstream: market data bundle and journal snippets
skills.use: Build the market bundle from MCP-server outputs.

skills.name: trade-performance-coach
skills.use: Trade records from `state/` and `portfolio/transactions.csv`.

skills.name: trader-memory-core
skills.upstream: local thesis state, with FMP for prices
skills.use: Theses in `state/theses/`, journal in `state/journal/`. Mark-to-market prices come from `get_symbol_data_batch` (skip `fmp_price_adapter.py`).

skills.name: trading-skills-navigator
skills.use: Treat any `api_profile` (fmp-required, alpaca and so on) as served by the workspace MCP servers through these adapters, except skills marked opt-in or partial. Run workflows with the `trading-workflow` skill.

skills.name: uptrend-analyzer
skills.use: Approximate the uptrend ratio per sector with `run_screener` counts (`totalCount`) of stocks above SMA50 and SMA200, divided by the sector total.
skills.gaps: TraderMonty's dataset is not used. Label the results as approximations.

skills.name: us-market-bubble-detector
skills.use: Use the MCP servers where they have the data: VIX (`CBOE:VIX`, Yahoo `^VIX`), index valuation from `get_symbol_data`, put/call series if `search_symbols` finds them.
skills.gaps: Margin debt, IPO counts and survey sentiment are not available. Ask the user or mark them as missing.

skills.name: us-stock-analysis
skills.use: Fundamentals from `get_financials`, `get_financial_history` and `get_forecasts`; technicals from `get_technicals_rating` and `get_ohlcv`; news from `get_news`.

skills.name: value-dividend-screener
skills.use: `run_screener` with P/E below 20, P/B below 2, dividend yield of at least 3% and the skill's other filters; growth from `get_financial_history`.

skills.name: vcp-screener
skills.use: Universe: S&P 500 members from `run_screener` (index filter) with trend-template filters (price above SMA50 above SMA200, near the 52-week high). Analyze contractions from `get_ohlcv` daily bars.

skills.name: weekly-performance-digest
skills.use: No market data needed.

skills.name: us-undervalued-growth-screener
skills.upstream: FMP, SEC EDGAR, company IR sites and official macro sources
skills.use: Screening from `run_screener`; 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings and IR material from `get_documents` and `get_document_view`; macro data from `get_economic_data`. The pipeline supports `--offline` and `--input`.

skills.name: finance-sentiment
skills.upstream: the Adanos Finance API (Reddit, X, news and Polymarket sentiment; API key)
skills.use: By default, use the sentiment method of `ta-sentiment-analyst` (news flow, analyst consensus, technical consensus).

skills.name: fintel-data
skills.upstream: the Fintel API or MCP server (short interest, ownership, insiders; paid key)
skills.use: Without opt-in, short-interest data is not available; ownership snapshots may come from `yahoo-finance` `get_holder_info`.

skills.name: hormuz-strait
skills.upstream: the Hormuz Strait Monitor web dashboard
skills.use: By default, use Brent and WTI prices (`TVC:UKOIL`, `TVC:USOIL`) and `get_news` on them.

skills.name: hyperliquid-reader
skills.use: By default, use crypto prices from the MCP servers.

skills.name: tradingview-mcp
skills.use: This workspace runs that server as `tradingmcp` (pinned PyPI release `tradingview-mcp-server`), so its tools work as described, subject to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (for example, its technical tools do not accept NSE or BSE; use `technicals`). With the official TradingView MCP instead, map `stock_prices` -> `get_symbol_data_batch`, `coin_analysis` and `multi_timeframe_analysis` -> `get_technicals_rating`, the scans -> `run_screener`, and `financial_news` -> `get_news`.
skills.gaps: With the official TradingView MCP, option chains and the built-in backtests are not available; use `backtest-expert` or `manifoldbt-backtester` for backtests.

skills.name: tradingview-reader
skills.upstream: the TradingView desktop app (macOS) through opencli and CDP
skills.use: By default, the official MCP covers quotes, screener, news, watchlists and alerts.
skills.gaps: Option Greeks and chart screenshots are available only through this opt-in path.

skills.name: company-valuation
skills.use: `get_financials`, `get_financial_history`, `get_forecasts` and `get_symbol_data`; peers from `run_screener`. Do not run the yfinance code.

skills.name: earnings-preview
skills.use: `get_earnings_calendar`, `get_forecasts`, `get_financial_history` (`fq`) and `get_ohlcv`.
skills.gaps: Whisper numbers and the full beat/miss history may be unavailable.

skills.name: earnings-recap
skills.use: `get_financial_history` (`fq`), `get_earnings_calendar`, `get_documents` then `get_document_view` (results, transcript), and `get_ohlcv` for the price reaction.

skills.name: estimate-analysis
skills.use: `get_forecasts` (consensus EPS and revenue, ranges, price targets, rating split).
skills.gaps: The 7/30/60/90-day revision history is generally not available; `yahoo-finance` `get_recommendations` (`upgrades_downgrades`) gives rating changes for US names. Compare with earlier saved reports if any exist.

skills.name: etf-premium
skills.use: Price from `get_symbol_data`; NAV and premium/discount columns if `get_screener_columns` lists them (search 'nav').
skills.gaps: Intraday NAV and holdings-based decomposition may be unavailable.

skills.name: options-payoff
skills.use: Spot price from `get_symbol_data`. The payoff chart and Black-Scholes values are computed locally; take premiums and IV from the user.
skills.gaps: Option chains come from a server that provides them (for example `yahoo-finance` `get_option_chain`, US listings); otherwise take premiums and IV from the user.

skills.name: saas-valuation-compression
skills.upstream: web research on private funding rounds
skills.use: Public SaaS multiples (EV/revenue and growth) from `run_screener`. Take private round data from the user.
skills.gaps: Private funding-round data is not in the MCP servers. Web search is opt-in only.

skills.name: sepa-strategy
skills.use: `get_ohlcv` (daily and weekly) for stage analysis, the trend template and VCP; `get_financial_history` for EPS and sales acceleration; `get_ohlcv` on `SP:SPX` or `NSE:NIFTY` for the market environment.

skills.name: stock-correlation
skills.use: `get_ohlcv` for each symbol over the same interval and window. Compute returns only from those bars.

skills.name: stock-liquidity
skills.use: Volume, average volume, dollar volume and turnover from `get_ohlcv` and `get_symbol_data`; bid/ask columns if `get_screener_columns` lists them.
skills.gaps: Order-book depth is not available. Options volume and open interest come from an option-chain tool if a server provides one.

skills.name: yfinance-data
skills.use: The `yahoo-finance` MCP server covers Yahoo data for default work; this skill runs the yfinance library directly, so it stays opt-in.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.use: Create skills in `.github/skills/` and keep the workspace data rules in `.github/tradingview-adapter.md` in new skills.

skills.name: discord-reader
skills.upstream: the Discord desktop app through opencli

skills.name: opencli-reader
skills.upstream: opencli access to Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Reuters, Reddit and 100+ other sites

skills.name: yc-reader
skills.upstream: the yc-oss public Y Combinator dataset

skills.name: startup-analysis
skills.use: For listed companies, use the MCP data servers instead.

skills.name: generative-ui
skills.use: In VS Code, write a standalone HTML file under `reports/` and open it in a browser.
